findings.message: A downgraded account is applying more carried quota than the downgrade policy allows.
findings.remediation: Apply the downgrade carry limit or hold the invoice for contract review.

findings.message: The same rollover lot appears more than once and could be carried forward twice.
findings.remediation: Deduplicate rollover lots by immutable lot id before invoice generation.

findings.message: Expired quota was applied to the current invoice.
findings.remediation: Remove expired lots from available balance and route the invoice to finance review.

findings.message: The invoice preview is not on hold despite quota rollover blockers.
findings.remediation: Place the invoice on finance hold until quota carry-forward and overage lines reconcile.

findings.message: Invoice overage units do not subtract applied rollover correctly.
findings.remediation: Recompute overage after rollover application to prevent double billing.

findings.message: Prior-cycle unused quota exceeds the contractual rollover cap.
findings.remediation: Clamp carry-forward units to the plan cap and regenerate the invoice preview before release.

findings.message: Negative quota adjustments exist without finance approval.
findings.remediation: Require finance approval before negative units affect quota or invoice totals.
